context: The item is a used smartphone in good condition.
transcript: Buyer ($60): Hello! I am very interested in purchasing your used smartphone. Would you be open to an initial offer of $60?

Seller ($180): Hi there! I appreciate your interest, but $60 is unfortunately much too low given that the phone is in great condition with no major flaws. I want to be fair, so I can lower my asking price to $180 for you today.

Buyer ($100): I completely understand that it is in great condition, but $180 is still a bit beyond my planned budget. Could we compromise and meet closer to the middle at $100? I am ready to complete the purchase right away.

Seller ($150): I appreciate your quick readiness to buy, but $100 is still too low for a fully functional phone in great shape. To help you get closer to your budget, I can lower my offer to $150, which is my absolute lowest price. Let me know if that works for you!
Buyer ($150): That sounds completely fair to me, and I really appreciate you working with my budget! I accept your offer of $150. <AGREEMENT>
